dict.string:
HelpView is a **SwiftUI framework** that adds AI-powered FAQ documentation to your iOS and macOS apps.
**Key Features:** - Natural language search using Apple Intelligence - Automatic fallback to text-based search - Support for JSON and plist FAQ formats - Beautiful, native SwiftUI interface - Full markdown support in answers - Topic-based organization
All AI processing happens **on-device** with Apple's Foundation Models—no network required!

**Platform Requirements:** - iOS 26.0 or later - macOS 26.0 or later - Swift 6.2+
**For AI Features:** - A17 Pro or M1+ chip - Apple Intelligence enabled in Settings - Language model downloaded
The SDK works on all supported platforms, but **Apple Intelligence features** are only available on devices with the required hardware.
How do I add HelpView to my project?

**Using Swift Package Manager:**
1. In Xcode, go to **File → Add Package Dependencies** 2. Enter the repository URL 3. Choose your version requirements 4. Add the package to your target
**Import in your code:** ```swift import HelpView ```
Then use either `HelpViewButton` for quick integration or `HelpContentView` for custom navigation flows.
What's the difference between HelpViewButton and HelpContentView?

HelpView provides **two public APIs** for different use cases:
**HelpViewButton** - Quick Integration - Displays a question mark button - Presents FAQs in a modal sheet - Includes built-in "Done" button - Perfect for toolbar placement
```swift .toolbar { HelpViewButton(named: "app_help") } ```
**HelpContentView** - Custom Navigation - Embeddable content view - No modal presentation or Done button - Full control over navigation - Works with NavigationLink, TabView, etc.
```swift NavigationLink("Help") { HelpContentView(named: "app_help") } ```
How do I create FAQ content?

Create a **JSON** or **plist** file in your app bundle:
**JSON Format:** ```json { "topics": ["Getting Started", "Features"], "faqs": [ { "title": "How do I use this?", "details": "Here's how to use...", "topic": "Getting Started" } ] } ```
**Required Steps:** 1. Create your FAQ file 2. Add it to your Xcode project 3. Ensure it's in **Copy Bundle Resources** build phase 4. Reference it by name (without extension):
```swift HelpViewButton(named: "app_help") ```
Can I use plist files instead of JSON?

Yes! HelpView supports both **JSON** and **plist** formats.
**Plist Structure:** ```xml <dict> <key>topics</key> <array> <string>Getting Started</string> </array> <key>faqs</key> <array> <dict> <key>title</key> <string>Your question</string> <key>details</key> <string>Your answer</string> <key>topic</key> <string>Getting Started</string> </dict> </array> </dict> ```
**Format Detection:** The loader tries `.json` first, then `.plist` automatically. Just use the filename without extension.
How does Apple Intelligence integration work?

HelpView automatically uses **Apple Intelligence** when available:
**Availability Check:** - Detects if Apple Intelligence is enabled - Checks if language model is downloaded - Verifies device has required hardware
**AI-Powered Search:** - Natural language understanding - Context-aware responses - Structured answers using `@Generable` macro - All processing happens **on-device**
**Automatic Fallback:** If Apple Intelligence isn't available, HelpView seamlessly falls back to text-based search—no additional code needed!
Does HelpView work without Apple Intelligence?

**Yes!** HelpView works on all supported devices.
**Without Apple Intelligence:** - Uses text-based search - Matches keywords in FAQ titles and content - Full markdown rendering - Topic-based browsing
**With Apple Intelligence:** - Natural language queries - Context-aware responses - Better search relevance
The SDK **automatically detects** what's available and adapts accordingly. No special handling required in your code!
Can I use markdown in FAQ answers?

Yes! All FAQ answers support **full markdown formatting**:
**Supported Elements:** - **Bold** and *italic* text - Headers (# ## ###) - Bullet lists - Numbered lists - Code blocks - Links - Block quotes
**Example:** ```json { "title": "How do I format text?", "details": "Use **bold** for emphasis and `code` for technical terms." } ```
Markdown is rendered using SwiftUI's built-in markdown support for native, beautiful typography.

FAQs are organized by **topics** for easy browsing:
**Topic Assignment:** - Each FAQ can have a `topic` field - FAQs without a topic go to "General" - Topics appear in the order specified in `topics` array
**Example:** ```json { "topics": ["Setup", "Usage", "Troubleshooting"], "faqs": [ { "title": "How to install?", "topic": "Setup" } ] } ```
Users can browse by topic or use search to find specific answers quickly.

**Absolutely!** HelpView is built with privacy in mind:
✓ **100% on-device processing** - No network requests ✓ **No data collection** - We don't track anything ✓ **No analytics** - Your users' queries stay private ✓ **Apple Intelligence** uses on-device models only ✓ **Open source** - You can review all the code
FAQ content is bundled with your app, and all AI processing happens locally using Apple's Foundation Models framework.

HelpView uses **native SwiftUI styling** that automatically adapts to your app:
**Automatic Adaptation:** - Respects system color scheme (light/dark mode) - Uses system fonts and sizing - Follows platform conventions (iOS vs macOS) - Supports Dynamic Type for accessibility
**Current Customization:** The SDK currently provides a polished, native experience out of the box. Theme customization options are planned for future releases.
The focus is on **consistency** with system UI patterns.
